Name: Achan
Summary: Achan, son of Carmi, took devoted plunder at Jericho and brought defeat on Israel at Ai, and he and his household were stoned in the Valley of Achor.
KeyStory: When Israel fled before Ai, Joshua found that Achan had hidden a Babylonian garment, silver, and gold in his tent, and Israel stoned him and burned what was his.
RelatedPeople: Carmi, Son of Zabdi; Zabdi, Father of Carmi; Joshua
LifeLesson: One man's hidden sin can defeat a whole people — and confession is the only way back.
